_comment: Asking a townsperson about its town (docs/PLAYER_TALK.md section D, batch 1; TownTalk.java). 'answers': the phrases players type (the longest phrase found wins, against Drifter's own too). 'lines': its answers by voice. {player} is what it calls them, {town} its town, {leader} its leader; some kinds fill more: {laws}, {count}, {days}, {what} and {way} (a place and which way), {goods} and {who} (the stall), {crime} {fine} (the law). Started by tools/chat_more/town_talk_seed.py; more lines added with merge.py.
